title: Fabrication of Microneedle Patches
author: Stephania Konstantinidi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8cehste
materials: The microneedles are ready for use.

steps.title: Clean PDMS molds
steps.instruction: Rinse and wipe the polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) molds to remove any debris.

steps.title: Heat water to 100 °C
steps.instruction: Place deionised water in a beaker and heat it to 100 °C.

steps.title: Submerge molds and stir
steps.instruction: Place the cleaned molds into the 100 °C water and stir gently.

steps.title: Dry molds in hood
steps.instruction: Take the molds out of the water and allow them to dry in a chemical hood for 1–2 hours.

steps.title: Attach molds to container
steps.instruction: Secure the dried molds to the bottom of an appropriate receptacle using double‑sided tape.

steps.title: Prepare PVA solution
steps.instruction: Heat 28 g of deionised water to 110 °C, add 4 g poly(vinyl alcohol) (30–70 kDa, 10 wt %) powder, and stir until the solution becomes transparent.

substeps.instruction: Add 4 g poly(vinyl alcohol) (30–70 kDa, 10 wt %) powder.
Stir until the solution is transparent.

steps.title: Add PVA solution to molds
steps.instruction: Pipette 1.5 mL of the prepared PVA solution onto each mold.

steps.title: Centrifuge molds
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the molds at 4000 rpm for 20 minutes while maintaining 40 °C.

steps.title: Dry microneedles overnight
steps.instruction: Leave the microneedles to dry in a chemical hood overnight.

steps.title: Remove microneedles from molds
steps.instruction: Gently remove the solidified microneedles from the molds.
